selected_script.angle: Preventing rug corner sliding and curling with flat L-shaped grippers
selected_script.hook: A foot steps on a curled rug corner, sliding it out of place

timeline.scene: Close-up of a foot stepping on a curled rug corner on a light oak floor, sliding it out of place.
Rug corner is lifted; a flat matte black L-shaped sticker is applied to the underside and pressed flat.
A foot steps firmly on the rug corner, which now stays completely flat.
Show a grey rug on tile floor with the sticker hidden underneath, staying perfectly flat.
A robot vacuum cleaner rolls over the flat rug corner smoothly without catching.
Wide shot of the flat rug in a clean living room. CTA: Keep your rugs flat and in place.
